secrets.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
secrets.description: GitHub personal access token for the repository this app was imported from. Used by the launcher dashboard to list workflow runs, read artifacts and dispatch the 'Build SHRP Reborn' workflow. A classic PAT needs the 'repo' and 'workflow' scopes; a fine-grained PAT needs 'Actions: read and write' plus 'Contents: read' on this repository. Optional at boot: the dashboard starts, but shows a 'Token missing' notice until it is set.
